args.query: SELECT name, type, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','view') ORDER BY name;

WITH cutoff AS (SELECT datetime('now', '-2 years') AS cut) SELECT 'included' AS which, experiment_id FROM experiments WHERE created_at < (SELECT cut FROM cutoff) UNION ALL SELECT 'excluded' AS which, experiment_id FROM experiments WHERE created_at >= (SELECT cut FROM cutoff) ORDER BY which, experiment_id;
